voice.caption: A north wind drives the ships off course for nine days.
They land among the Lotus-eaters and send three scouts inland.
Those who taste it lose all desire for home.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Take them, though they weep — bind them under the benches! The rest of you aboard and to your oars now, before another man tastes the lotus and forgets his home.

keys.beat: They land among the Lotus-eaters and send three scouts inland.
Those who ate lotus forgot home and wanted to stay.
Odysseus drags the weeping men back, binds them under the benches, and orders immediate departure.
